rationale: Price is at 96.7% of today's range and within 0.16% of the session high with only 26 minutes to close, creating an unfavorable risk/reward for a long entry at extended levels. A short against the high is equally unattractive given the strong momentum spike in the last two candles (volume surge to 48k+ pushing price from $20.95 to $21.23) and a bullish market backdrop (SPY +0.66%, VIXY -1.14%). With no news catalyst to explain the move and insufficient time to develop a clean reversal setup, the asymmetry does not favor either direction.
